benchmarks.name: tumbler-garments
benchmarks.description: Rotating tumbler drum with four garments: multi-layer cloth self-contact, continuous frictional sliding, shell bending and one kinematic affine-body drum
benchmarks.comparability: The geometry is procedural, so the scene parameters are the assets: keep the drum spec (R=0.30 m, depth 0.40 m, 3 lifters, 48 segments), 40 rpm, dt=1/60, the four garments and their placement, the 6.2 mm element size, the shell moduli/thickness, d_hat and the friction table unchanged -- each of them moves the contact count. Compare identical repo, samples, CUDA, GPU, driver, and frame counts.

benchmarks.name: crease-press
benchmarks.description: Cyclic press creasing a mixed stack of seven clamped sheets: Dahl internal-friction denim + strain-plastic cardboard + stress-plastic sheet-metal discrete-shell bending, cloth layer-layer and tool contact + friction, NeoHookeanShell2D membrane, one kinematic affine-body press bar, two press cycles at two lateral offsets
benchmarks.comparability: The geometry is procedural, so the scene parameters are the assets: keep the sheet footprints (0.48 x 0.80 m), the 7-sheet stack order and layer gap, the denim element size (10 mm) and carton element size (14.5 mm), the shell moduli/thicknesses/yield thresholds, d_hat and the friction table, the press schedule (depth 0.10 m below the stack's rest top surface, die 75 mm under the rest plane, crease offsets +-80 mm, dt=1/60, tol_rate 1e-4) and the 130-frame default unchanged -- each of them moves the hinge count, the contact count or the solver path. Compare identical repo, samples, CUDA, GPU, driver, and frame counts. The CP_* environment variables are calibration overrides and are unset by the benchmark so a stray export cannot silently change the scene.
